verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost identical, and both have the same problems. The FREE ENTRY, ALL AGES and TASTINGS pills zigzag left and right at random offsets, and they are about as big and prominent as the RSVP Free button, which pulls attention away from the CTA. The date and time block is left-aligned against a centred headline, and the 'missing asset / partner' placeholder runs off the right edge and is cut off. B's logo is scaled wider and almost touches the canvas edges, while A's logo keeps a little more margin, so A is marginally better.
